title: Is There a ‘Safest Seat’ in a Train Crash? Experts Say It’s Not So Simple.
summary_full: After a high-speed collision near Toledo, Spain, killed at least 69 people, rail safety experts said the rough consensus that it is best to sit in the middle of a train has its limits.
